user_model_brief: Meta engineer on the workbench/workbench-meta personal-assistant pipeline. Wants stable item identity assigned at ingestion and preserved across the whole lifecycle, hierarchical lineage IDs (#123, #123.1, #123.1.2 arbitrary depth), an item page listing sub-actions collapsed, and an action page with parent breadcrumb. Prefers lower-dependency solutions (chose materialized path over ltree), DB-enforced integrity, append-only immutable identity. Stack: FastAPI+Postgres+Alembic backend, React+TS+TanStack Query+Vite UI. TDD with red-green-commit.
